description: Behavior-first traceability for release-critical Construct capabilities. Entries describe observable outcomes and must be declared by each mapped test using an @capability comment.

capabilities.outcome: A user can export a compacted chat continuation and receive a readable markdown artifact inside the active project's .cx storage.
failureModes: export falls back to user-global storage for a project session
continuation layers are not rehydrated in the export
assertions: export path remains under the active temporary project's .cx/chat-sessions/exports directory
exported markdown reports the compacted continuation and re-derived static instructions

capabilities.outcome: Typed artifacts with required structure and visuals pass release validation, while unknown artifact types fail closed.
assertions: known good templates pass their declared checks

capabilities.outcome: A user can ingest supported local documents into project knowledge or an explicit sibling markdown target.
failureModes: ingest writes outside the requested project target
supported documents are skipped during recursive ingest
assertions: default ingestion writes normalized markdown into project knowledge
recursive ingestion includes supported files and excludes unsupported files

capabilities.outcome: A user can generate a truthful Construct demo tape even when an optional recorder is unavailable.
failureModes: demo crashes without an external recorder
terminal tape presents an unrelated vanilla theme or bypasses Construct chat
assertions: the shipped tape drives construct chat with the Construct Cockpit theme
